page_title: New Molecular Entity Approvals for 2011 (FDA Drug Innovation)

rows_to_add.indication: To treat patients with acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL), who have developed an allergy (hypersensitivity) to E. coli derived asparaginase and pegaspargase chemotherapy drugs used to treat ALL.
rows_to_add.applicant_on_table: link to BLA 125359 (EUSA Pharma; US commercialization by Jazz Pharmaceuticals)

rows_to_add.indication: To treat patients with iron overload due to blood transfusions in patients with thalassemia, a genetic blood disorder that causes anemia, who had an inadequate response to prior chelation therapy.
For the treatment of acute attacks of hereditary angioedema (HAE) in people ages 18 years and older.
For the long term, once-daily maintenance bronchodilator treatment of airflow obstruction in people with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) including chronic bronchitis and/or emphysema.
For use as an add-on medication to treat seizures associated with epilepsy in adults.
rows_to_add.applicant_on_table: NDA 022345 (GlaxoSmithKline; US rights with Valeant from 2013). IRREGULARITY: Potiga later restricted for retinal abnormalities; marketed as Trobalt in EU.

rows_to_add.indication: For the treatment of HIV-1 infection in adults who have never taken HIV therapy.
In combination with prednisone to treat patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer who have received prior docetaxel chemotherapy.
rows_to_add.applicant_on_table: NDA 202379 (Centocor Ortho Biotech/J&J; licensed from Cougar Biotechnology)

rows_to_add.indication: A once-daily treatment for moderate-to-severe restless legs syndrome (RLS).
For use in patients undergoing magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the central nervous system.
For the treatment of head lice infestation in patients ages 4 years and older.
An imaging drug used to assist in the evaluation of adult patients with suspected Parkinsonian syndromes (PS).
